related.description: Browser MCP is a Model Context Provider (MCP) server that allows AI applications to control your browser
Unified MCP server for App Store Connect & Google Play Console — 91 tools for listings, screenshots, releases, reviews & submissions
MCP server + Chrome extension that gives AI agents control of your real browser with existing sessions and logins
MCP server for Meta Marketing API v25.0 — 135 tools for Facebook & Instagram ad campaign management
MCP server for Instagram Graph API, Threads API & Meta platform — 57 tools with Graph API v25.0
